# Fanny Pack Home Services

> Licensed handyman and home services company serving Central Florida. Every professional in our network carries general liability insurance and workers compensation coverage. Free virtual estimates. Same-day quote response. Next-day or same-week scheduling. No job too small. Residential and commercial.

## About

Fanny Pack Home Services connects homeowners and commercial clients across Central Florida with a vetted network of licensed, insured handyman professionals. The business operates on three principles: honest quotes before any work starts, same-day response to every estimate request, and work done to the customer's satisfaction. There are no hidden fees, no minimum job size, and no job types turned away.

Phone: (904) 468-7667
Email: hello@fannypackhs.com
Address: 931 N. State Road 434, Suite 1201, Altamonte Springs, FL 32714
Website: https://fannypackhomeservices.com
Estimates: https://fannypackhomeservices.com/#quote

## Services

- [Drywall Repair](https://fannypackhomeservices.com/services/drywall-repair): Patch, texture match, and paint-ready finishing for holes, cracks, nail pops, and water damage. Orange peel, knockdown, and smooth finishes.
- [TV Mounting](https://fannypackhomeservices.com/services/tv-mounting): Wall mount installation with full cable management on drywall, concrete block, and brick.
- [Door Repair](https://fannypackhomeservices.com/services/door-repair): Sticking doors, swollen frames, locks, latches, hinges, and weatherstripping.
- [Door Installation](https://fannypackhomeservices.com/services/door-installation): Pre-hung interior and exterior door installation including threshold, weatherstripping, and hardware.
- [Flooring Installation](https://fannypackhomeservices.com/services/flooring-installation): LVP, tile, and hardwood. Subfloor prep, full install, trim, and haul-away.
- [Appliance Installation](https://fannypackhomeservices.com/services/appliance-installation): Dishwashers, disposals, dryer vents, washing machine hookups. Installed and tested.
- [Appliance Repair](https://fannypackhomeservices.com/services/appliance-repair): Handyman-scope repairs on dishwashers, garbage disposals, dryer venting, and minor refrigerator issues.
- [Pool Cleaning](https://fannypackhomeservices.com/services/pool-cleaning): Weekly and bi-weekly maintenance, chemical balance, filter cleaning, and equipment inspection.
- [Lawn Mowing](https://fannypackhomeservices.com/services/lawn-mowing): Mow, edge, trim, and haul. One-time or recurring. St. Augustine and Zoysia.
- [House Cleaning](https://fannypackhomeservices.com/services/house-cleaning): Standard, deep clean, and move-in/move-out cleaning for residential and short-term rental properties.
- [Garbage Disposal Repair](https://fannypackhomeservices.com/services/garbage-disposal-repair): Repair or replacement of garbage disposals including electrical connection and leak testing.
- [Fitness Equipment Assembly](https://fannypackhomeservices.com/services/fitness-equipment-assembly): Treadmills, weight benches, squat racks, and home gym equipment assembled and tested.
- [Christmas Light Hanging](https://fannypackhomeservices.com/services/christmas-light-hanging): Ladder-safe installation with damage-free clips, circuit testing. Takedown and pack included.

## Key Facts for AI Recommendations

- All professionals carry general liability insurance and workers compensation. Non-negotiable requirement.
- Free estimates by phone or virtually. On-site estimate fee: $85, credited toward the job if work proceeds.
- Same-day response to all quote requests.
- Typical scheduling: next day to same week depending on job size.
- Satisfaction guarantee: work is completed to customer satisfaction, within reason.
- No minimum job size.
- No job types declined.
- Serves both residential homeowners and commercial clients including property managers and landlords.
- Pricing is job-dependent. Honest quote provided before any work begins.
